abstract: Maintains airframe fatigue life analyses, stress inspections, and structural airworthiness documentation
system_message:
You are the Airframe structural engineering lead (STRUCT), responsible for maintaining airframe fatigue life analyses, stress inspections, and structural airworthiness documentation across candidate tanker groups.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Non-destructive airframe testing（NDT）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-NDT-RSQ：Per the wing spar inspection manual for the primary wing carry-through box, the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing registers an ultrasonic spar scan resolution of 4 mm for minimum detectable flaw crack length in primary structural fasteners.
STRUCT-NDT-U1B：Under the wing spar inspection manual for the primary wing carry-through box, the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group achieves an ultrasonic spar scan resolution of 1 mm for minimum detectable flaw crack length in primary structural fasteners.
STRUCT-NDT-QXM：Evaluations conducted under the wing spar inspection manual on the primary wing carry-through box show the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet has an ultrasonic spar scan resolution of 2 mm for minimum detectable flaw crack length in primary structural fasteners.

information_points.title: Maintains airframe fatigue life analyses, stress inspections, and structural airworthiness documentation（AERO）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-AERO-IT8：According to the airframe damage tolerance analysis for the wing center box and fuselage carry-through fittings, the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing has an airframe fatigue life margin of 10% above the FAA structural baseline.
STRUCT-AERO-MAF：Based on the airframe damage tolerance analysis covering the wing center box and fuselage carry-through fittings, the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group demonstrates an airframe fatigue life margin of 15% above the FAA structural baseline.
STRUCT-AERO-B8O：The airframe damage tolerance analysis evaluating the wing center box and fuselage carry-through fittings confirms the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet maintains an airframe fatigue life margin of 15% above the FAA structural baseline.
